BiblicalUsage: Beathah means fear, terror, dread, and Jeremiah uses it when the people look for peace and find no good, and when they ask why God has utterly rejected them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fear without peace is the fruit of a people who have turned from God, and Jeremiah's question is still the right one to ask.
